responsibility: This machine-description file defines the unspec and expander patterns used to realize NDS32 builtins and special architectural operations that are not ordinary generic RTL instructions. It covers system-register transfers, barriers, interrupt-control operations, cache/TLB and FPU control instructions, unaligned access expanders, and other volatile or side-effect-heavy primitives that nds32-intrinsic.cc maps builtins onto, making it the md-side companion to the intrinsic expander code.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/nds32/nds32-intrinsic.cc, this machine-description file is the declarative pattern side: it defines the unspec/expand/insn RTL patterns for intrinsic-only operations such as system-register access, interrupt control, cache/TLB/FPU control, and unaligned access that the C++ builtin expander targets.
